Product Inventory Management Using Object Pointers
Problem Statement

Design a C++ program to manage product details using:

Objects

Pointers to objects

Dynamic memory allocation

User input

The program must demonstrate how to create an object using a pointer and access its members using the arrow (->) operator.

Requirements
Create a class Product
Private Data Members:

string productName

int productID

double price

int quantity

Public Member Functions:

void setDetails(string name, int id, double p, int q)

Initialize product details

double calculateTotalValue()

Returns:

price × quantity

void display()

Print:

Product Name: <name>
Product ID: <id>
Price: <price upto 2 decimal places>
Quantity: <quantity>
Total Value: <price × quantity upto 2 decimal places>

Input Format

Single line input:

productName productID price quantity

Output Format

Display product details exactly as specified.
